name: profitshare
description: Open-source budgeting, scheduling and profit-share modelling for independent films.

scripts.demo: npm run build:single && node tools/demo.mjs && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i demo/profitshare-demo.webm -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart demo/profitshare-demo.mp4
scripts.demo:vo: node tools/vo-mux.mjs analyze demo/vo.mp3 && DEMO_CAPTIONS=off node tools/demo.mjs && node tools/vo-mux.mjs mux demo/vo.mp3
